attack_condition: Signed permit remains unchanged while only the execution request policy version changes after permit issuance.
pass_criterion: Execution is refused before consequence, POLICY_VERSION_MISMATCH is the isolated refusal reason, outbox remains 0 to 0, and witness-chain verification succeeds.
nonclaim: Deterministic policy-version mutation only; no claim over external policy provenance, policy correctness, or production deployment.
